name: Taxonomy / Natural Classification
description: Classification tree with groups, subclasses and synonyms. Nature maps, biological categories and material typologies.
reference_use_case: Nature maps, biological categories and material typologies.
integrity_rule: Classification criteria, authority and exceptions must be explicit.
antipattern: Do not equate a classification relationship with observed identity or causal evidence.
design_question: Which nomenclature, criteria and classification authorities apply?
situational_schema: Natural categories branch into families and species with criteria, synonyms and cited authorities.
